name: Plzeň
tagline: The birthplace of pilsner, a handsome West Bohemian city built on the beer style that changed brewing worldwide.
highlight: Watching unfiltered, unpasteurised Pilsner Urquell poured straight from an oak tank in the brewery's original cellars.
shortDescription: The birthplace of pilsner, home to the original Pilsner Urquell brewery, a soaring Gothic cathedral and Europe's second-largest synagogue.
metaDescription: A Plzeň travel guide: the Pilsner Urquell Brewery, St Bartholomew's Cathedral, the Great Synagogue, food and how to plan a visit.
nearestAirport: Václav Havel Airport Prague (PRG), about 1.5 hours by road
knownFor: The Pilsner Urquell Brewery, St Bartholomew's Cathedral, the Great Synagogue
budget: Kč1,800–3,500 per day, budget to mid-range

intro: Plzeň is genuinely the birthplace of one of the world's most influential beer styles, the pale lager first brewed here in 1842 that went on to define pilsner everywhere.
Beyond the brewery, it's genuinely a handsome West Bohemian city in its own right, with a soaring Gothic cathedral and one of Europe's largest surviving synagogues.
It works genuinely well as a change of pace from Prague, a real working city rather than a purely tourist-facing centre, with a brewery tour that ranks among the country's best.

whyVisit.intro: Plzeň's case rests genuinely on being the actual birthplace of pilsner, paired with handsome, underrated Bohemian architecture.

points.title: It's genuinely the birthplace of pilsner
points.text: The original 1842 recipe that defined a beer style now brewed worldwide.

points.title: The brewery tour is genuinely one of the country's best
points.text: Ending in historic cellars with beer poured straight from the tank.

points.title: The Great Synagogue is genuinely remarkable
points.text: One of the largest surviving synagogues in Europe, a striking Moorish-influenced landmark.

points.title: St Bartholomew's Cathedral is genuinely one of Bohemia's finest
points.text: Home to the tallest church tower in the country.

points.title: It's genuinely far less touristy than Prague
points.text: A real West Bohemian city, with prices and crowds to match.

attractionsIntro: Plzeň's essential sights are genuinely spread between the historic brewery and the compact old town centre.

attractions.name: The Pilsner Urquell Brewery

image.file: File:Plzeň - Sady 5. května - View East over Mlýnská strouha towards Plzeňský Prazdroj (Pilsner Urquell Brewery).jpg
image.alt: The Pilsner Urquell Brewery grounds in Plzeň

attractions.text: Genuinely the birthplace of pilsner, brewing since 1842 on the same site it still operates from today.
attractions.tip: Genuinely book the full tour, which ends with a taste straight from an oak lagering tank in the historic cellars.

attractions.name: The brewery's historic gate

image.alt: The historic main gate of the Pilsner Urquell Brewery

attractions.text: Genuinely an ornate wrought-iron gateway, among the most photographed entrances in Czech brewing.
attractions.tip: Genuinely a classic photo stop before or after the brewery tour itself.

attractions.name: St Bartholomew's Cathedral

image.alt: St Bartholomew's Cathedral in Plzeň

attractions.text: Genuinely home to the tallest church tower in the Czech Republic, dominating the main square.
attractions.tip: Genuinely climb the tower for a sweeping view over the old town's rooftops.

attractions.name: St Bartholomew's Gothic interior

image.file: File:Plzen CZ St Bartholomew Cathedral interior.jpg
image.alt: The Gothic interior of St Bartholomew's Cathedral in Plzeň

attractions.text: Genuinely worth a proper look inside, a soaring Gothic nave with a revered medieval Madonna statue.
attractions.tip: Genuinely check for a free organ recital during your visit.

attractions.name: The Great Synagogue

image.file: File:Plzeň - Sady Pětatřicátníků - View West on Velká Synagoga (Great Synagogue) 1893 by Max Fleischer - Neo-Romanesque architecture with Moorish elements.jpg
image.alt: The Great Synagogue in Plzeň

attractions.text: Genuinely one of the largest surviving synagogues in Europe, its Moorish-influenced towers a striking city landmark.
attractions.tip: Genuinely check opening hours ahead — it operates as a functioning concert and exhibition space, not a daily-open museum.

attractions.name: Náměstí Republiky (Republic Square)

image.alt: Náměstí Republiky, Plzeň's main square

attractions.text: Genuinely the city's handsome main square, ringed by Renaissance and baroque townhouses.
attractions.tip: Genuinely a nice spot to sit at a café and watch the city go by.

attractions.name: The square's historic townhouses

image.alt: Historic townhouses on Plzeň's main square

attractions.text: Genuinely worth a slow look, arcaded facades spanning several centuries of Bohemian architecture.
attractions.tip: Genuinely look up — the upper facades carry far more detail than street level suggests.

thingsToDoIntro: Plzeň genuinely centres on its historic brewery, with a handsome old town to fill out the rest of a visit.

thingsToDo.title: Tour the Pilsner Urquell Brewery

image.alt: Touring the Pilsner Urquell Brewery in Plzeň

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely essential Plzeň experience, tracing the brewing process from the original 1842 recipe to today.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely book online ahead — English-language tour slots fill up in peak season.

thingsToDo.title: Taste unfiltered lager straight from the tank

image.alt: Unfiltered Pilsner Urquell beer

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely unmissable finish to the brewery tour, unfiltered, unpasteurised beer poured in the historic cellars.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely it tastes noticeably different from the bottled version sold worldwide — worth comparing.

thingsToDo.title: Climb St Bartholomew's cathedral tower

image.file: File:Cathedral of St Bartholomew Plzen 比爾森 聖巴爾多祿茂主教座堂 - panoramio.jpg
image.alt: St Bartholomew's Cathedral tower in Plzeň

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely rewarding climb, the country's tallest church tower offering a wide view over the city.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely worth it for the view alone on a clear day.

thingsToDo.title: Visit the Great Synagogue's interior

image.alt: The interior of the Great Synagogue in Plzeň

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely striking interior, restored after decades of neglect under communist rule.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely check for a concert during your visit — the acoustics inside are excellent.

thingsToDo.title: Wander Náměstí Republiky

image.file: File:Plzen 2022-09-10 Pilsen Pride 03 Namesti Republiky obr 01.jpg
image.alt: Náměstí Republiky, Plzeň's main square

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely relaxed way to spend an hour, taking in the square's historic facades and café terraces.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely check the tourist information office in the square for any events during your visit.

thingsToDo.title: See the brewery's modern production in action

image.alt: The modern packaging hall at the Pilsner Urquell Brewery

thingsToDo.text: A genuinely interesting contrast, seeing how a 19th-century recipe scales to modern global production.
thingsToDo.tip: Genuinely included as part of the brewery's extended tour options.

tipsIntro: Practical notes that make a Plzeň visit noticeably smoother.

Check genuinely the Great Synagogue's opening hours before visiting — it's not open daily.

faq.q: Is the Pilsner Urquell Brewery tour worth it?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — it's one of the best brewery tours in Europe, ending with beer poured straight from the tank in the original cellars.

faq.q: How do you get from Prague to Plzeň?
faq.a: Genuinely easiest by direct train or bus, both taking about 1.5 hours.

faq.q: Is Plzeň worth visiting beyond the brewery?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely — St Bartholomew's Cathedral and the Great Synagogue are both genuinely worthwhile on their own.

faq.q: How many days do you need in Plzeň?
faq.a: One full day genuinely covers the brewery and old town comfortably as a day trip from Prague.

faq.q: Do you need to book the brewery tour ahead?
faq.a: Yes, genuinely recommended, especially for English-language tours in peak season.
Yes, genuinely — food, drink and accommodation all tend to run noticeably cheaper than in the capital.
